title: pin(types): `safeValidateSchema` refuses an off-type declared key on the root node and accepts the same node nested — characterising pin for #7869
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #17, `session_01XesLUWmuhjuRwmU618AZ1M`, GitHub `hotlong`) on the maintainer's batch-#3 ruling on #7869 (option C, 2026-09-07): the severable slice the triage seat named on that card (5571731776) — a characterising pin that no ruling blocks — split out so the measured defect is held by a test while the repair waits on the #5250 programme. `pm:queue` under the SKILL.md rule that the queue takes test-only pins of a measured behaviour.

## What the pin asserts (current behaviour, measured on `origin/main` `3f93fe47d` by #7869)

One node, two calls to `safeValidateSchema` (`packages/types/src/zod/index.zod.ts`):

- root: `{ type: 'icon', icon: 'star', size: 'sm' }` → `success: false` (`IconSchema.size` is `z.number()`, `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts:160`)
- nested: `{ type: 'flex', children: [ { type: 'icon', icon: 'star', size: 'sm' } ] }` → `success: true` (the child is matched against `BaseSchemaCore` `.passthrough()`, `base.zod.ts:53` / `:241`, not against `AnyComponentSchema`)

Both readings are pinned side by side in one test file next to the existing `index.zod` tests, each with its control: the well-typed node (`size: 24`) passes in both positions. The test's name and docblock state that the nested `true` is the #7869 defect held in place, ⛔ not a specification — when the #5250 programme lands per-depth dispatch, this pin is the one that goes red and is rewritten as the strict-face assertion, on purpose.

## Boundaries

- ⛔ No change to any schema, mirror, or `safeValidateSchema` itself; test-only. `Clause-②: no`.
- ⛔ Not a fix for #7869 and does not close it — `Refs #7869` only, no closing keyword (#7869 is `pm:blocked` on #5250).
- Changeset: `skip-changeset` (nothing publishes).
- Size XS. The dev seat re-measures both readings on the current head before writing the assertions; if either has moved, stop and report on this card — a pin of a behaviour that no longer holds is not written.

Refs #7869 · #5250 (the programme) · #7581 / PR #7916 (the measuring tool, a different population)
